attempts.summary: Built a three-member etcd 3.6.10 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (Alpine Linux) using apk-installed etcd with openrc, configured via /etc/etcd/conf.yml with static initial-cluster bootstrap over each node's real IP. Verified cross-node read/write replication, verified the cluster keeps serving writes/reads with one member down (quorum preserved with 2/3), and verified the down member resyncs missed writes upon rejoining. Then executed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_id and etcd health/data on all 3 nodes, restarted each node one at a time via native reboot (with quorum-preserving writes proven mid-restart for node2 and node3), polled until each came back, confirmed changed boot_id per node, and confirmed post-restart etcd health, cluster membership (3/3), and data integrity (including keys written while that specific node was offline) on each node before moving to the next.
